items.title: 6 Critical F5 BIG-IP Vulnerabilities Could Let Hackers Disrupt Websites and Execute Malicious Code
items.description: F5 released emergency fixes for six critical BIG-IP vulnerabilities that could let remote attackers take websites and other services offline without logging in. The flaws affect specific traffic-handling configurations. An attacker who can reach a vulnerable service could crash the BIG-IP process that handles client traffic. items.description: Meta-owned WhatsApp has addressed security vulnerabilities, including one impacting its Android app that it suspects may have been exploited in connection with scam messages. items.title: Over 100 Debian Packages Still Contain Distrusted CA Certificates Despite Security Updates
items.description: A scan of a Debian package mirror found that more than 100 packages still contained copies of distrusted certificate authority (CA) certificates after Debian removed them from its system trust store.
